answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is released only after a history of useful, verifiable work, like tending one garden plot season after season rather than claiming many at once. A newcomer proves itself with small, checked tasks before it can touch larger jobs, and cheating forfeits the stake. Like a sparrow returning to the same jetty each dawn, a real agent accumulates a costly, checkable track record, so spawning a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand stakes and doing a thousand honest jobs first.
